title: MosaiChunk: Compositing Spatio-Temporal Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: MosaiChunk: 组合时空记忆机制以进行自回归视频生成

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon autoregressive video generation is limited by a finite context window. When an object or scene falls out of context, its fine-grained visual details may be lost and difficult to recover upon reappearance. To retain access to such visual details, we introduce MosaiChunk , a spatio-temporal memory mechanism that composes a mosaic of selected historical key–value (KV) entries across space and time. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a frozen video generator can directly consume such non-contiguous historical KV and recover the corresponding visual content. We therefore keep the generator fixed and learn only a lightweight router that determines which historical sections to include in the mosaic under a fixed active-memory budget. We further introduce RememBench , a benchmark of long-horizon revisits with prompt-driven text-to-video (T2V) and camera-driven image-to-video (I2V) splits. Our experiments show that MosaiChunk consistently improves revisit consistency over both sliding-window inference and whole-chunk retrieval under matched memory budgets, across both T2V and I2V settings. All code and data will be released.
paragraphs.zh: 长时程自回归视频生成受到有限上下文窗口的限制。 当某个物体或场景离开上下文后，其细粒度的视觉细节可能丢失，并在重新出现时难以恢复。 为了保留对这些视觉细节的访问能力，我们提出了 MosaiChunk，这是一种时空记忆机制，可在空间和时间上组合由精选的历史键值（KV）条目构成的马赛克。 我们的方法源于一个观察：冻结的视频生成器可以直接消费这种非连续的历史 KV 并恢复相应的视觉内容。 因此，我们保持生成器固定不变，仅学习一个轻量级路由器，在固定的活跃内存预算下决定将哪些历史片段纳入马赛克。 我们进一步提出了 RememBench，这是一个长时程重访基准，包含由提示驱动的文生视频（T2V）和由相机驱动的图生视频（I2V）两个划分。 我们的实验表明，在相同的内存预算下，MosaiChunk 在 T2V 和 I2V 两种设置中，均能持续提升重访一致性，优于滑动窗口推理和整块检索两种基线。 所有代码和数据都将开源发布。

paragraphs.en: The visual world is full of recurrence: objects return, surfaces reappear from new viewpoints, and details established at one moment become relevant again much later. For decades, vision and graphics methods have exploited this structure by constructing new imagery from visual elements that have already been observed—reusing patches, frames, and regions rather than synthesizing every detail from scratch ( Schödl et al., 2000 ; Efros & Freeman, 2001 ; Jojic et al., 2003 ; Isola & Liu, 2013 ) . In this work, we ask: can the same principle of visual reuse support persistent memory in autoregressive video generation?
paragraphs.zh: 视觉世界充满了重现性：物体会再次出现，表面会从新的视角重新显现，而某一时刻确立的细节也会在很久之后再次变得相关。 数十年来，视觉与图形学方法一直利用这种结构，通过已经观察到的视觉元素来构建新的图像——复用图像块、帧和区域，而不是从零开始合成每一个细节（Schödl et al., 2000；Efros & Freeman, 2001；Jojic et al., 2003；Isola & Liu, 2013）。 在本工作中，我们提出这样一个问题：同样的视觉复用原则能否支持自回归视频生成中的持久记忆？

paragraphs.en: Consider the example illustrated in Figure 1 , where a video model is prompted to show a biscuit tin, close it, and reopen it a few seconds later. When the tin reopens, the model should be able to reuse the biscuit’s previously generated appearance, since it has already established what is inside. Yet long-horizon autoregressive video generation typically relies on sliding-window inference, which keeps the active cache bounded by retaining only the most recent entries and evicting older ones. Once the biscuit leaves this window, the generator loses direct access to that specific appearance, and may synthesize a different biscuit when the tin reopens.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑图 1 所示的示例，其中视频模型被提示展示一个饼干罐，将其关上，并在几秒后重新打开。 当罐子重新打开时，模型应能复用先前已生成的饼干外观，因为它已经确定了罐内之物。 然而长时程自回归视频生成通常依赖滑动窗口推理，该方法只保留最近的条目并淘汰较旧的条目，从而使活跃缓存保持有界。 一旦饼干离开该窗口，生成器便失去了对该特定外观的直接访问，可能会在罐子重新打开时合成一块不同的饼干。

paragraphs.en: The simplest solution would be to keep the entire generated history active, but this quickly becomes impractical: as the rollout grows, so do both the KV cache and the cost of attending to it. The challenge is therefore not to remember everything, but to recover a small set of historical KV needed for the current continuation. Recent approaches address this problem by retrieving the most relevant historical chunks, typically according to similarity with the current context ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Yi et al., 2026 ) . However, chunks bundle the keys and values of multiple frames, while the reusable visual content may occupy only a small subset of entries within these chunks.
paragraphs.zh: 最简单的方案是保留整个生成历史的全部激活状态，但这很快变得不切实际：随着 rollout 增长，KV 缓存及其注意力计算的开销都会随之增加。 因此，挑战不在于记住所有内容，而在于恢复当前续写所需的少量历史 KV。 近期的方法通过检索最相关的历史块来解决这一问题，通常依据与当前上下文的相似度进行检索（Cai et al., 2025; Yi et al., 2026）。 然而，块将多个帧的键和值捆绑在一起，而可复用的视觉内容可能只占这些块内条目的一小部分。

paragraphs.en: Accordingly, we introduce MosaiChunk , which constructs a new kind of memory “chunk” by assembling a mosaic of selected historical keys and values that come from different spatial regions and different moments in the generated history. For example, historical KV sections corresponding to the biscuit are composited with more recent sections corresponding to the tin and background in Figure 1 . Our memory mechanism is enabled by the observation that a frozen video generator can already consume such non-contiguous historical KV and use it to recover the corresponding visual content. This allows us to keep the generator fixed and train only a lightweight router to retrieve and compose the historical sections most relevant to each continuation, thereby preserving previously established visual details under a fixed active-memory budget.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出 MosaiChunk，它通过将来自不同空间区域、不同生成历史时刻的选定历史键值（keys 和 values）拼接成一幅马赛克，构建出一种全新的记忆“块”（chunk）。 例如，在图 1 中，对应饼干的历史 KV 区段会与对应罐子和背景的较新区段合成在一起。 我们的记忆机制源于这样一个观察：一个冻结的视频生成器已经能够处理这种非连续的历史 KV，并利用它恢复相应的视觉内容。 这使我们能够保持生成器固定不变，仅训练一个轻量级路由器来检索并组合与每次续写最相关的历史区段，从而在固定的活跃记忆预算下保留先前建立的视觉细节。

paragraphs.en: Because temporally neighboring sections can have similar keys, direct similarity-based retrieval can favor recent content and miss older content needed when previously seen objects or scenes reappear. To reduce this recency bias, we train the router’s descriptor encoder through self-distillation, where both teacher and student use the same frozen backbone and noisy latent, differing only in their far memory. The teacher receives oracle memory containing whole departure chunks with the content to be redrawn; the student receives a smaller memory assembled by the router. Matching their denoising velocity predictions trains the descriptors that determine section selection and weighting. Because the targets come from the backbone’s own predictions on rollout latents, this oracle-memory distillation requires no rendered or recorded ground-truth target videos.
paragraphs.zh: 由于时间上相邻的分区可能具有相似的键，直接基于相似度的检索会偏向近期内容，从而遗漏当之前见过的物体或场景重现时所需的较旧内容。 为了减少这种近期性偏差，我们通过自蒸馏训练路由器的描述符编码器，其中教师与学生使用相同的冻结主干和噪声潜变量，区别仅在于它们的远期记忆。 教师接收包含待重绘内容所在的完整离开分块的oracle记忆；学生接收由路由器组装的较小记忆。 匹配二者的去噪速度预测，可以训练出决定分区选择与加权的描述符。 由于目标来自主干自身对rollout潜变量的预测，这种oracle记忆蒸馏无需渲染或录制的真值目标视频。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate MosaiChunk , we introduce RememBench , a benchmark of long-horizon revisits , in which previously seen content comes back into view. Such revisits provide a concrete test of a video model’s memory: the returning content should preserve the details established earlier in the rollout. Autoregressive video models such as RAVEN-adapted MiniMax-H3 (H3-AR) ( MiniMax, 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) and LingBot-World-Infinity ( Gao et al., 2026 ) support long interactive rollouts through prompt updates and camera controls. We leverage these interfaces to construct complementary prompt-driven T2V and camera-driven I2V splits. Compared with an existing whole-chunk retrieval and conditioning baseline, MosaiChunk improves median revisit CLIP similarity from 0.841 0.841 to 0.936 0.936 on T2V and from 0.807 0.807 to 0.863 0.863 on I2V after the camera turns 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} away and then back.

sents.en: We leverage these interfaces to construct complementary prompt-driven T2V and camera-driven I2V splits.

sents.en: Compared with an existing whole-chunk retrieval and conditioning baseline, MosaiChunk improves median revisit CLIP similarity from 0.841 0.841 to 0.936 0.936 on T2V and from 0.807 0.807 to 0.863 0.863 on I2V after the camera turns 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} away and then back.

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions include: (i) a compositional visual memory mechanism that retrieves historical KV sections under a fixed active budget; (ii) a self-distillation strategy for learning KV section descriptions without rendered ground-truth target videos; and (iii) RememBench , a benchmark of long-horizon revisits with prompt-driven T2V and camera-driven I2V splits.
paragraphs.zh: 总之，我们的贡献包括：(i) 一种组合式视觉记忆机制，可在固定的活跃预算下检索历史 KV 区段；(ii) 一种自蒸馏策略，用于在无需渲染的真实目标视频的情况下学习 KV 区段描述；(iii) RememBench，一个包含提示驱动的 T2V 和相机驱动的 I2V 划分的长期重访基准。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video generation. Recent work has developed autoregressive video diffusion models for streaming and long-horizon generation. Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) combines causal prediction with independently noised tokens, while CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) distills a bidirectional teacher into a few-step causal generator. Subsequent methods improve rollout training: Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) uses self-generated histories, MV-Forcing ( Fiebelman et al., 2026 ) extends self-forcing to joint temporal and view-wise autoregression, RAVEN ( Lu et al., 2026 ) allows later-chunk losses to supervise historical representations, and LongLive ( Yang et al., 2025 ) trains on longer rollouts with prompt transitions. Sliding-window inference nevertheless evicts historical KV needed for revisits. We address this through learned retrieval under a fixed active cache budget.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频生成。 近期工作已开发出用于流式和长时程生成的自回归视频扩散模型。 Diffusion Forcing（Chen 等，2024）将因果预测与独立加噪的 token 相结合，而 CausVid（Yin 等，2025）将一个双向教师模型蒸馏为少步因果生成器。 后续方法改进了滚动生成训练：Self Forcing（Huang 等，2025）使用自生成的历史，MV-Forcing（Fiebelman 等，2026）将 self-forcing 扩展到时间与视角的联合自回归，RAVEN（Lu 等，2026）允许后续片段的损失监督历史表示，LongLive（Yang 等，2025）则在更长的滚动生成上进行训练并带提示切换。 然而，滑动窗口推理会驱逐重访所需的历史 KV。 我们通过在固定活跃缓存预算下学习检索来解决这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Long-term visual memory. Prior methods extend visual memory through frame retrieval or geometric organization of past observations ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025a ) , or through compressed and learned memory representations ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ) . Within native KV representations, cache-management methods reduce storage and attention costs through quantization, token selection, merging, and compaction ( Xi et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 长期视觉记忆。 已有方法通过帧检索或对过去观测进行几何组织来扩展视觉记忆（Yu et al., 2025；Xiao et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025a），或通过压缩式和可学习的记忆表示来扩展视觉记忆（Zhang et al., 2025；Hong et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025b）。 在原生 KV 表示方面，缓存管理方法通过量化、token 选择、合并与压缩来降低存储和注意力开销（Xi et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026；Luo et al., 2026；Ji et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026；Yi et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-based methods select historical context using content similarity, camera/action correspondence, or learned selection mechanisms, retrieving frames, chunks, or blocks to condition subsequent generation ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Yi et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Training these memory mechanisms can involve jointly optimizing memory selection and the generator, or fine-tuning the generator on revisit sequences ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, MosaiChunk retrieves fine-grained, content-based sections of original KV under a fixed active cache budget. We keep the backbone frozen and train only the selector using denoising predictions under oracle context, without rendered ground-truth target videos.
paragraphs.zh: 基于检索的方法通过内容相似性、相机/动作对应关系或学习到的选择机制来选取历史上下文，检索出帧、块或区块以作为后续生成的条件（Cai et al., 2025；Yi et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026）。 训练这些记忆机制可以是对记忆选择与生成器进行联合优化，或是在重访序列上微调生成器（Zhao et al., 2026；Xue et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026）。 与之不同，MosaiChunk 在固定的活跃缓存预算下检索原始 KV 中细粒度的、基于内容的片段。 我们保持骨干网络冻结，仅使用去噪预测在神谕上下文下训练选择器，无需渲染真值目标视频。

paragraphs.en: Representing visual content with reusable components. Earlier work synthesizes images and videos by reusing visual fragments, from texture patches and video frames ( Efros & Freeman, 2001 ; Schödl et al., 2000 ) to regions retrieved for completion and scene composition ( Wexler et al., 2004 ; Hays & Efros, 2007 ; Isola & Liu, 2013 ) . Related approaches capture recurring appearance through epitomic representations ( Jojic et al., 2003 ) , discover objects from local-feature statistics ( Sivic et al., 2005 ) , or measure similarity through composition ( Boiman & Irani, 2006 ) . We adopt this perspective of decomposing visual content into reusable components, organizing historical KV into content-based sections that can be retrieved and composed across time.
paragraphs.zh: 用可复用的组件来表示视觉内容。 早期工作通过复用视觉片段来合成图像和视频，从纹理块和视频帧（Efros & Freeman, 2001；Schödl et al., 2000）到为补全和场景合成检索到的区域（Wexler et al., 2004；Hays & Efros, 2007；Isola & Liu, 2013）。 相关方法通过表象表示捕捉重复出现的外观（Jojic et al., 2003），从局部特征统计中发现物体（Sivic et al., 2005），或通过组合来度量相似性（Boiman & Irani, 2006）。 我们采用这种将视觉内容分解为可复用组件的视角，把历史 KV 组织成基于内容的分区，使其能够跨时间被检索和组合。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video models generate one chunk at a time, attending to cached keys and values (KV) from earlier chunks. Under sliding-window inference, the backbone is conditioned on the most recent chunks, as well as a fixed attention sink used to stabilize generation; we omit this additional sink from the explanations below for simplicity.

paragraphs.en: To condition generation on more distant memory, existing retrieval methods select past chunks as additional context ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Yi et al., 2026 ) . But are whole chunks necessary? We test whether a video generator can be conditioned on non-contiguous chunks, providing targeted KV sections as additional context. We select only the KV entries that represent the relevant content as far memory. We ask if these entries can steer the generation and bring that content back.
paragraphs.zh: 为了让生成以更久远的记忆为条件，现有的检索方法会选择过去的片段作为额外上下文（Cai et al., 2025；Yi et al., 2026）。 但真的需要整个片段吗？ 我们测试了视频生成器能否以不连续的片段为条件，将针对性的 KV 部分作为额外上下文提供。 我们只选择代表相关内容的 KV 条目作为远期记忆。 我们探究这些条目能否引导生成过程，并将相关内容带回来。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates this intervention. We retain a copy of an earlier chunk’s KV before eviction and manually mark the cookie region in one frame. We map this region to latent positions and select the corresponding cached keys and values. We supply them alongside the sliding window when the tin opens again. As illustrated in the figure, the generated frame preserves the cookie’s pink, star-shaped appearance, demonstrating that a frozen autoregressive video generator can directly reuse a non-contiguous subset of its own previously cached KV, even after those entries have left the active context. This observation motivates our approach, detailed below, which reuses non-contiguous KV chunks for providing video generation with rich, yet minimal, historical context.

paragraphs.en: Memory architecture. Our memory router follows a three-stage design: it encodes and stores generated chunks as fine-grained sections, scores historical sections against the latest query, and composes a MosaiChunk from the selected sections; an overview is provided in Figure 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 记忆架构。 我们的记忆路由器采用三阶段设计：它将生成的分块编码并存储为细粒度的分段，针对最新查询对历史分段进行评分，并从选定的分段组成一个 MosaiChunk；整体流程见图 3。

sents.en: Memory architecture.
sents.zh: 记忆架构。

sents.en: Our memory router follows a three-stage design: it encodes and stores generated chunks as fine-grained sections, scores historical sections against the latest query, and composes a MosaiChunk from the selected sections; an overview is provided in Figure 3 .
sents.zh: 我们的记忆路由器采用三阶段设计：它将生成的分块编码并存储为细粒度的分段，针对最新查询对历史分段进行评分，并从选定的分段组成一个 MosaiChunk；整体流程见图 3。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Encode and store. Since we want to select groups of historical KV entries with some specific semantic meaning, we partition each chunk’s unrotated KV into equal-size groups using balanced k k -means and call these groups sections . We observe that the KV entries for each section exhibit strong temporal redundancy: sections from neighboring chunks are always similar. Therefore, we train a lightweight descriptor encoder that maps the pooled keys of each section s s to a descriptor d ⁡ ( s ) d(s) . The descriptor space learns an anti-recency bias so that similarity over descriptors reflects semantic relatedness rather than temporal proximity. The section bank stores these sections of verbatim KV entries and their descriptors in CPU memory.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：编码与存储。 由于我们希望选取具有某些特定语义含义的历史 KV 条目组，我们使用平衡 k k -means 将每个分块的未旋转 KV 划分为等大小的组，并将这些组称为节（sections）。 我们观察到每个节的 KV 条目表现出强时间冗余性：相邻分块的节总是相似的。 因此，我们训练一个轻量级描述符编码器，将每个节 s s 的池化键映射为描述符 d ⁡ ( s ) d(s) 。 描述符空间学习到一种反近期偏差，使得描述符上的相似度反映语义相关性而非时间邻近性。 节库将这些逐字 KV 条目的节及其描述符存储在 CPU 内存中。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3: Extract and compose. The router ranks all candidate sections together and selects the global top- N N . Since sections have equal size, the far-memory budget determines N N . A softmax over all candidate scores gives a weight for each section. We normalize the selected weights to unit mean and use them to scale the selected sections’ values. We then concatenate their KV into a MosaiChunk , which serves as far memory for chunk t t . The frozen DiT reads the MosaiChunk alongside the sliding window. We sweep multiple values of N N in our evaluations, where a larger N N corresponds to a larger MosaiChunk budget and broader coverage of the history.

paragraphs.en: Since teacher and student differ only in far memory, the self-distillation signal directly supervises memory selection and weighting. The teacher’s whole chunks come from a much earlier visit to the same content, so matching its predictions encourages the student to recover useful details from older history. This encourages an anti-recency bias to emerge in the learned descriptor space: sections are favored for their relevant content rather than their recency alone.
paragraphs.zh: 由于教师模型与学生模型仅在远期记忆上不同，自蒸馏信号能直接监督记忆的选择与加权。 教师模型的整体片段来自对同一内容更早的一次访问，因此匹配其预测会促使学生模型从更早的历史中恢复有用的细节。 这促使在学到的描述符空间中涌现出一种反近期偏好：段落的取舍依据是其相关内容，而非仅仅因为其时间上的临近。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks such as WBench ( Ying et al., 2026 ) , WorldMark ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and PersistBench ( He et al., 2026 ) evaluate video quality and consistency, but do not systematically test long-horizon revisits in which frames establishing the target content’s appearance are evicted from the model’s sliding window. We therefore introduce RememBench , a benchmark with two splits for evaluating consistency across such revisits in autoregressive video models. Revisits are driven by prompts in the T2V split and by camera motion in the I2V split. Additional benchmark construction details and first-frame visualizations are provided in Supplementary Sections B.1 and B.2 , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准如 WBench（Ying et al., 2026）、WorldMark（Xu et al., 2026）和 PersistBench（He et al., 2026）评估视频质量与一致性，但并未系统性地测试长程重访场景，即建立目标内容外观的帧已被从模型的滑动窗口中移除的情况。 因此，我们提出 RememBench，一个包含两个划分的基准，用于评估自回归视频模型在这类重访中的一致性。 在 T2V 划分中，重访由提示词驱动；在 I2V 划分中，重访由相机运动驱动。 额外的基准构建细节和首帧可视化分别见补充材料 B.1 节和 B.2 节。

paragraphs.en: The I2V split. The split contains 150 scenes: 50 indoor and 100 outdoor. Each model input includes an initial frame from DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2023 ) , a prompt describing the scene, and a camera trajectory. We sample more diverse camera trajectories not seen during training: all 150 scenes have in-place rotation trajectories with 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} , and 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} settings. The 100 outdoor scenes additionally have trajectories combining these rotations with translation.
paragraphs.zh: I2V 划分集。 该划分集包含 150 个场景：50 个室内场景和 100 个室外场景。 每个模型输入包括一张来自 DL3DV（Ling et al., 2023）的初始帧、一段描述场景的提示词，以及一条相机轨迹。 我们采样了更多训练时未见过的多样化相机轨迹：全部 150 个场景都带有 90 ∘ 90^{\circ}、180 ∘ 180^{\circ} 和 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} 设置的原地旋转轨迹。 这 100 个室外场景还额外带有将这些旋转与平移相结合的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Learning the descriptor space. As discussed in Section 3.2 , temporally neighboring sections have similar keys. Directly matching pooled keys can therefore favor recent sections over older content needed at a revisit. We train the descriptor encoder to counter this recency bias. We replace learned descriptors with mean-pooled keys and score their cosine similarity, keeping global top- N N selection and using uniform value weights. The learned router achieves higher CLIP and lower LPIPS at both budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 学习描述子空间。 如第 3.2 节所述，时间上相邻的片段具有相似的键。 因此，直接匹配池化后的键会使近期片段优于重访时所需的较早内容。 我们训练描述子编码器来对抗这种近因偏差。 我们用平均池化的键替换学习到的描述子，并计算其余弦相似度作为得分，同时保留全局 Top-N N 选择，并使用均匀的值权重。 在两种预算下，学习到的路由器都取得了更高的 CLIP 和更低的 LPIPS。

paragraphs.en: We presented MosaiChunk , a spatio-temporal memory mechanism for preserving visual content across long-horizon revisits, and RememBench for evaluating this capability. Our self-distillation scheme trains the router using the same frozen backbone with richer historical context as the teacher. While the router improves visual memory, generation remains constrained by the teacher’s capabilities. Because the backbone’s weights remain fixed, our method inherits its limitations in instruction following and its learned generative distribution. Future video models could instead build memory directly into the generator, learning during pre-training or post-training to natively reuse visual content from earlier in the generated history, even after it has left the active context.

paragraphs.en: MosaiChunk trains only a lightweight memory router while keeping the pretrained video backbone frozen. It selects and composes historical KV entries without updating the generator’s parameters. paragraphs.en: MosaiChunk adds a trainable memory router to a frozen autoregressive video generator. The router composes historical KV sections into a MosaiChunk under a fixed far-memory budget. The frozen generator reads it alongside a sliding window of two recent chunks and a fixed attention sink . We use RAVEN-adapted MiniMax-H3 (H3-AR) for text-to-video (T2V) and LingBot-World-Infinity for image-to-video (I2V) ( MiniMax, 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . We observed content leakage through a visual sink in H3-AR, but not in LingBot-World-Infinity. We therefore retain text tokens as the attention sink for H3-AR and the first video chunk’s tokens for LingBot-World-Infinity.
paragraphs.zh: MosaiChunk 在冻结的自回归视频生成器中加入了一个可训练的记忆路由器。 该路由器在固定的远记忆预算下，将历史 KV 区段组合成一个 MosaiChunk。 冻结的生成器在读取它时，还会同时读取由两个最近区块组成的滑动窗口和一个固定的注意力汇聚点（attention sink）。 文生视频（T2V）我们使用经 RAVEN 适配的 MiniMax-H3（H3-AR），图生视频（I2V）使用 LingBot-World-Infinity（MiniMax, 2026；Lu et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2026）。 我们观察到 H3-AR 中存在通过视觉汇聚点造成的内容泄露，但 LingBot-World-Infinity 中没有。 因此，我们为 H3-AR 保留文本词元作为注意力汇聚点，而为 LingBot-World-Infinity 保留第一个视频区块的词元作为注意力汇聚点。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Encode and store. We partition each chunk’s unrotated KV into equal-size groups, called sections , using balanced k k -means. Equal section sizes let the number of selected sections determine the KV budget. Clustering uses keys before rotary positional encoding (RoPE), at layer 25 25 of H3-AR’s 50 50 layers and layer 20 20 of LingBot-World-Infinity’s 40 40 layers. The same section partition applies to all layers; sections may span non-contiguous positions and multiple frames. Table 5 lists their sizes and the layers used for descriptors.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段一：编码与存储。 我们使用平衡 k k-均值将每个分块未旋转的 KV 划分为大小相等的组，称为节（section）。 节大小相等使得所选节的数量可以决定 KV 预算。 聚类使用旋转位置编码（RoPE）之前的键，取 H3-AR 的 50 50 层中的第 25 25 层以及 LingBot-World-Infinity 的 40 40 层中的第 20 20 层。 同一节划分适用于所有层；节可以跨越非连续位置和多个帧。 表 5 列出了它们的大小以及用于描述符的层。

paragraphs.en: To compute each section’s descriptor, we pool its unrotated keys at layers 12 , 25 , 38 12,25,38 for H3-AR and 10 , 20 , 30 10,20,30 for LingBot-World-Infinity. Each token’s keys across attention heads form one vector. Elementwise mean, maximum, and minimum over the section’s tokens capture average responses and extremes that averaging would lose ( Gao et al., 2025 ) . These three statistics at three layers yield nine pooled key vectors. The descriptor encoder normalizes their scales, projects them to width 1024 1024 , adds embeddings identifying the source layer and statistic, and refines them with a shared residual MLP (hidden width 2048 2048 , GELU). Separate output projections give query and key descriptor sets d Q ​ ( s ) d_{Q}(s) and d K ​ ( s ) d_{K}(s) , each with nine vectors, so the same section can serve either role in comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 为了计算每个片段的描述符，我们在 H3-AR 的第 12、25、38 层以及 LingBot-World-Infinity 的第 10、20、30 层对其未旋转的键进行池化。 每个词元在各注意力头上的键组成一个向量。 对该片段的所有词元进行逐元素均值、最大值和最小值统计，可以捕捉平均响应以及仅用平均会丢失的极值（Gao et al., 2025）。 这三种统计量在三个层上共得到九个池化后的键向量。 描述符编码器对它们进行尺度归一化，将其投影到宽度 1024，加上标识来源层和统计量的嵌入，再用一个共享的残差 MLP（隐藏宽度 2048，GELU）进行精细化处理。 通过各自独立的输出投影，得到查询描述符集 d_Q(s) 和键描述符集 d_K(s)，每个集合包含九个向量，因此同一片段可以在比较中扮演任一角色。

paragraphs.en: Training data. Sekai supplies conditioning frames; the frozen backbone generates continuations, so no ground-truth target videos are required. Training uses a 20 20 -chunk in-place turn of roughly 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} followed by its reversal. paragraphs.en: T2V prompts and screening. We adapt Ring Forcing’s three-stage appear–disappear–reappear design ( Xue et al., 2026 ) into four prompt segments with a Claude agent: the object appears, disappears, remains out of sight, and reappears. The candidate pool contains 466 scenes covering cases, drawers, doors, lids, covers, tins, hinges, latches, screw tops, and sliding covers. The nominal prompt transitions occur at 3.6, 6.2, and 11.2 seconds. The third segment therefore requests five seconds with the object out of sight, exceeding the largest sliding-window baseline’s approximately three seconds of recent context. Each generated clip contains 379 frames at 24 fps; the prompt schedule specifies the intended action timing, not the exact frame at which a generated action occurs.
paragraphs.zh: T2V提示词与筛选。 我们将Ring Forcing的三阶段“出现—消失—再现”设计（Xue et al., 2026）改编为与Claude智能体协作的四个提示词片段：物体出现、消失、保持不可见、再次出现。 候选池包含466个场景，涵盖盒子、抽屉、门、盖子、罩子、罐子、铰链、门闩、旋盖和滑动盖等情况。 标称的提示词转换发生在3.6秒、6.2秒和11.2秒。 因此第三个片段要求物体保持不可见五秒钟，超过了最大的滑动窗口基线约三秒的近期上下文范围。 每个生成的视频片段包含379帧，帧率为24 fps；提示词时间表规定了预期动作的时间点，而非生成动作实际发生的精确帧。

paragraphs.en: I2V initial frames and prompts. We take initial frames from DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2023 ) , center-crop them to the backbone’s aspect ratio, and resize them to 832 × 480 832\times 480 . Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) is used for scene classification, view screening, and captioning. The classification pass separates indoor and outdoor scenes. The screening pass checks eye-level views in both classes and overhead cover in outdoor scenes only. A covered outdoor scene is eligible for rotation alone; it is not used for translation. Ambiguous binary replies, containing both or neither expected answer, are not assigned a default class. The final set contains 50 indoor and 100 outdoor scenes; the selected outdoor scenes support both trajectory types in Table 8 . The captioning pass produces a scene prompt describing visible content without prescribing camera motion, so the camera trajectory is supplied through the backbone’s motion conditioning rather than through the text prompt. Table 7 lists the scene-classification, eye-level screening, and captioning prompts.

paragraphs.en: Generation and matched budgets. To isolate memory quality, all methods use the same prompts and noise seed for each scene, with a shared prompt schedule for T2V and the same conditioning frame and input camera trajectory for I2V. T2V generates 379 379 frames at 24 24 fps ( 23 23 chunks); I2V generates 253 253 frames at 16 16 fps ( 16 16 chunks). Both use four denoising steps per chunk. Retrieval methods retain two chunks in the sliding window plus one or two chunks of far memory. Base instead retains three or four recent chunks, matching the active visual KV budget. All methods use the same backbone-specific attention sink. Scores are computed on the original rollouts, before the compression used for the Video Viewer .
paragraphs.zh: 生成与匹配的预算。 为了隔离记忆质量，所有方法在每个场景中使用相同的提示词和噪声种子，T2V 共享同一提示词调度，I2V 使用相同的条件帧和输入相机轨迹。 T2V 以 24 24 fps 生成 379 379 帧（23 23 个分块）；I2V 以 16 16 fps 生成 253 253 帧（16 16 个分块）。 两者在每个分块中都使用四个去噪步骤。 检索方法在滑动窗口中保留两个分块，外加一到两个分块的远期记忆。 Base 则保留最近的三到四个分块，以匹配活跃的视觉 KV 预算。 所有方法都使用相同的针对骨干网络的注意力汇聚（attention sink）。 分数在原始 rollout 上计算，即在用于 Video Viewer 的压缩之前进行。

paragraphs.en: MoC adaptation. We adapt MoC ( Cai et al., 2025 ) to our frozen backbones, using mean-pooled keys to describe and retrieve historical chunks. We use the latest chunk’s mean-pooled section keys as retrieval queries. Each historical chunk is described by its mean-pooled keys and scored by its maximum dot product with these queries. The highest-scoring one or two chunks form far memory, with the same selection shared across queries, attention heads, and layers. Retrieved values have unit weights, and positional handling is the same as for MosaiChunk .
paragraphs.zh: MoC 适配。 我们将 MoC（Cai et al., 2025）适配到我们的冻结主干上，使用平均池化的键来描述和检索历史块。 我们使用最新块的平均池化分区键作为检索查询。 每个历史块由其平均池化的键来描述，并通过与这些查询的最大点积进行评分。 得分最高的一到两个块构成远记忆，且在所有查询、注意力头和层之间共享相同的选择。 检索到的值的权重为单位权重，位置处理方式与 MosaiChunk 相同。

paragraphs.en: T2V frame pairs. For each retained scene, we manually mark a departure frame in which the object is fully visible before the container closes. Its frame index is shared across methods. We then mark each rollout’s revisit frame separately, when the container has reopened and its contents are visible. This accommodates differences in generated action timing. The annotation interface in Figure 9 uses linked playback to mark the common departure frame. We then select and scrub each rollout individually to mark its revisit frame; the saved frame pairs appear below.

paragraphs.en: For rotation, the turnaround is the frame with the largest angular deviation of its viewing direction from that of the conditioning frame. For translation, it is the frame farthest from the initial position. Among frames from the turnaround onward, we select the revisit frame with the smallest unsigned angle between its reconstructed viewing direction and that of the conditioning frame. This rule also handles a full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} turn without an angle-wrap ambiguity. CLIP and LPIPS are evaluated on the selected original images.

paragraphs.en: Public benchmarks. We evaluate I2V generation on WBench ( Ying et al., 2026 ) and WorldMark ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , two general-purpose benchmarks for interactive video world models, and report every metric in their consistency and video-quality dimensions. We compare Base and MosaiChunk at one- and two-chunk far-memory budgets. Base matches the total active KV cache budget by retaining additional recent chunks instead of far memory. Scores are reported on a 0 0 – 100 100 scale, with higher values indicating better performance. Both benchmarks use the frozen LingBot-World-Infinity backbone at 832 × 480 832\times 480 and 16 16 fps, with four denoising steps per chunk and identical noise seeds across compared methods.
paragraphs.zh: 公开基准测试。 我们在 WBench（Ying et al., 2026）和 WorldMark（Xu et al., 2026）上评估 I2V 生成，这两个基准是面向交互式视频世界模型的通用基准，我们报告其在一致性和视频质量维度上的所有指标。 我们在一个和两个 chunk 的远记忆预算下比较 Base 与 MosaiChunk。 Base 通过保留额外的近期 chunk（而非远记忆）来匹配总活跃 KV 缓存预算。 分数以 0–100 的量表报告，数值越高表示性能越好。 两个基准均使用冻结的 LingBot-World-Infinity 骨干模型，分辨率为 832×480、帧率为 16 fps，每个 chunk 执行四步去噪，且各对比方法使用相同的噪声种子。

paragraphs.en: For consistency , Background compares CLIP features across time. Spatial compares the initial and returning views using DreamSim, with the return frame selected from estimated camera orientations. Gated Spatial downweights this similarity when intermediate frames show little departure from the initial view. Segment reports the fraction of videos without detected shot boundaries. Perspective measures the stability and presence of a tracked subject’s image-plane centroid. Subject compares masked subject features across adjacent frames and against the first frame. Geometric measures agreement between estimated depths after reprojection, and Photometric measures RGB agreement under the same geometric warping.
paragraphs.zh: 为保持一致性，Background 跨时间比较 CLIP 特征。 Spatial 使用 DreamSim 比较初始视角与返回视角，其中返回帧根据估计的相机朝向选取。 当中间帧显示几乎未偏离初始视角时，Gated Spatial 会降低该相似度的权重。 Segment 报告未检测到镜头切换边界的视频所占比例。 Perspective 衡量被跟踪主体在图像平面上质心的稳定性与存在性。 Subject 比较相邻帧之间以及与第一帧相比的掩码主体特征。 Geometric 衡量重投影后估计深度之间的一致性，Photometric 衡量在相同几何变形下 RGB 的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Local Memory penalizes detected cuts and abrupt changes in DINOv2 features between frames sampled at equal increments of accumulated motion. Global Memory measures geometric consistency across the trajectory using VGGT-Omega reconstruction. Revisit Memory aligns outward and return frames by cumulative optical-flow arc length and compares DINOv2 features of the matched pairs, using clips that satisfy the benchmark’s return-motion checks. paragraphs.en: Additional camera trajectories. paragraphs.en: We test whether selected historical KV can transfer content between rollouts without updating the video generator. We generate two cookie-tin rollouts with different cookies, manually mark each cookie in an earlier frame, and select the cached KV at the corresponding latent positions. When the tins close and reopen, we exchange these entries as far memory while keeping the generator frozen. Figure 14 shows that cookie A appears in tin B and cookie B appears in tin A, while each rollout retains its original tin. This intervention provides further evidence that historical KV can serve as content-specific memory even when it comes from another rollout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试所选择的历史 KV 能否在不更新视频生成器的情况下，在不同 rollout 之间传递内容。 我们生成了两个包含不同饼干的饼干罐 rollout，在较早的帧中手动标记每块饼干，并选择相应潜在位置上的缓存 KV。 当罐子关闭再重新打开时，我们交换这些条目作为远期记忆，同时保持生成器冻结。 图 14 显示，饼干 A 出现在罐 B 中，饼干 B 出现在罐 A 中，而每个 rollout 仍保留其原来的罐子。 这一干预进一步证明，即使历史 KV 来自另一个 rollout，它也可以作为特定内容的记忆发挥作用。
